Version 0.82.0

### ✨ New

- Added Git workflows for local projects; with an authorized Lody GitHub integration, GitHub PR workflows are available too.
- Support dragging sessions from the sidebar into the composer for automatic @ mentions.
- Sessions can now be forked into new worktrees for parallel approaches.
- Added global MCP configuration, selectable from the plus-button menu when creating a conversation.
- @ mentions in the composer now appear as chips, making sessions and skills easier to reference.
- Diff file titles now offer copy-path and open-file actions.
- Added a usage trends view with selectable time ranges.
- Subscriptions and redemption codes can now apply together.

### 🐛 Fixes and Improvements

- Improved scroll following in streaming conversations, terminal copy/paste, and text selection.
- Improved child-session navigation and presentation, including the hierarchical list on mobile.
- Fixed several reliability issues in workspace cleanup, session startup, and connection recovery.
- Optimized sidebar and page navigation performance to reduce unnecessary UI updates.
